Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1150213. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id corresponding to CHEMBL1150213, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order.
